# XHand vendor distribution

Official document: https://www.robotera.com/#/document/detail?doc=84

Python x86_64 SDK 1.1.8 archive:
https://cos.robotera.com/20260618/6916805cccc94ca3b3fd5ef6ee33ce7b.zip

Use `xhand_controller-1.1.8-cp310-cp310-linux_x86_64.whl` for this environment.
Vendor archives, binaries, examples and license files are retained locally and ignored by Git.
